name: middle-earth-adventure
description: A multiplayer text-based adventure game set in Middle Earth

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server
scripts.test:e2e:check: node -e "const http=require('http');http.get('http://localhost:3001/health',(r)=>{process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)}).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))" && echo '✅ Server is running' || echo '❌ Server not running - start with: npm run dev'
scripts.test:e2e:report:file: open playwright-report/index.html || xdg-open playwright-report/index.html || start playwright-report/index.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:e2e
